newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA SHARES PROBE RECORD ON ISSUE HOPES.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA SHARES PROBE RECORD ON ISSUE HOPES.

text.p: Shares in Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy rose on Friday in moderate trade on expectations that its planned share offering would pull in a high price, brokers said.
At 1310/1210 GMT, Kemira traded at 53.00, up 1.50 markka or 2.91 percent, matching its life high set on July 9. Volume was over nine million markkka.
"People are hoping for similar success to Valmet's issue and offering (this summer)," one broker said. "They expect a quite high issue price," he said.
But another broker said such hopes were probably in vain since much of the rise in Valmet's share price around its offering came from a share buy-back and the fact that it listed in the U.S.
Investors should wait for the share issue rather than buying on the market, he said.
"This has probably got to do with marketing the share issue," a third broker said.
Kemira last week announced plans to issue up to eight million new shares and the state said it would lower its stake in the company to 50.1 percent from 72.3 percent.
